summary: Comprehensive testing of archive/restore order functionality. All backend API tests and frontend UI tests passed successfully.
passed_tests: Backend: PUT /api/orders/{order_id}/archive requires authentication (returns 403 without token)
Backend: PUT /api/orders/{order_id}/archive returns 404 for non-existent order
Backend: PUT /api/orders/{order_id}/archive sets archived=true successfully
Backend: PUT /api/orders/{order_id}/restore requires authentication (returns 403 without token)
Backend: PUT /api/orders/{order_id}/restore returns 404 for non-existent order
Backend: PUT /api/orders/{order_id}/restore sets archived=false successfully
Backend: GET /api/orders excludes archived orders (archived: {$ne: true})
Backend: GET /api/orders/archived returns only archived orders
Backend: Archived orders include motorcycle data
Backend: Full archive->restore flow works correctly
Frontend: 'Archiveren' button (amber) appears on each order with data-testid='archive-order-btn-{id}'
Frontend: Archive confirmation dialog opens with Dutch text 'Bestelling Archiveren?'
Frontend: Archive dialog shows motorcycle brand and model in confirmation message
Frontend: Archive dialog has 'Annuleren' and 'Archiveren' buttons with correct data-testid
Frontend: Archive confirm button has amber styling (bg-amber-600)
Frontend: 'Bekijk Archief' button links to /dealer/orders/archived with data-testid='view-archived-orders-btn'
Frontend: Archived orders page shows title 'GEARCHIVEERDE BESTELLINGEN'
Frontend: Archived orders have grayscale effect on images
Frontend: Archived orders show 'Gearchiveerd' badge
Frontend: 'Herstellen' button (green) on archived orders with data-testid='restore-order-btn-{id}'
Frontend: Restore confirmation dialog opens with Dutch text 'Bestelling Herstellen?'
Frontend: Restore confirm button has green styling (bg-green-600)
Frontend: 'Terug naar Bestellingen' button links back to /dealer/orders with data-testid='back-to-orders-btn'
Frontend: Order moves from main list to archived after archiving
Frontend: Order moves from archived to main list after restoring
Frontend: Success toast 'Bestelling gearchiveerd' appears after archiving
Frontend: Success toast 'Bestelling hersteld' appears after restoring
critical_code_review_comments: Archive/restore endpoints properly check authorization - dealers can only archive/restore their own orders
GET /api/orders correctly filters out archived orders with {archived: {$ne: true}}
GET /api/orders/archived correctly returns only archived orders
Frontend uses proper Dutch translations from nl.json for all archive/restore text
All interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing
Archive button has amber styling, restore button has green styling as specified
Archived orders display with grayscale effect and 'Gearchiveerd' badge
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created - used existing archived order (Yamaha MT-07)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Archive/restore feature fully tested and working. The test dealer (zoektest@dealer.nl) currently has 1 archived order (Yamaha MT-07). The full flow was tested: restore archived order -> verify in main list -> archive again -> verify in archived list.

archive_endpoint.authorization: Dealers can only archive their own orders, admins can archive any

restore_endpoint.authorization: Dealers can only restore their own orders, admins can restore any

get_archived_orders_endpoint.behavior: Returns only archived orders for the current dealer

get_orders_excludes_archived.behavior: Excludes archived orders with filter {archived: {$ne: true}}
